notes.title: Update 0.16 - Voids Adrift Development Update: Ship Weapons Progress
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Greetings, Nomads![/b][/h1]

We're thrilled to share some exciting progress on ship weapons in Voids Adrift. Ship cannons and turrets will be essential for combat, and we're designing them in various tiers to match different gameplay styles.


[h2]Early Blender Renders[/h2]

[b]Concept Deckside Cannons:[/b]

Below, you’ll find some of our early concept renders for deckside cannons. These are just a few of the designs we’ve been working on. Currently, we have over 21 different cannons and ship turrets, including several styles of harpoon weapons.

[img] https://i.imgur.com/li1Ywi5.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vwvvjJB.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D5uF71k.png[/img]


[b]Textured Cannons:[/b]

Here are some examples of our textured cannons. The design, color, and shape of these cannons will vary based on the materials you use, ensuring a diverse and customizable combat experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JDIlXUA.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IyiLP2k.png[/img]

[b]Weapon Decay and Scrap System[/b]

Scrap Weapons:
We’re also developing a system for how weapons degrade over time. Weapons removed from ships, if left unattended, will eventually degrade into non-movable scrap. Players will be able to harvest these scrap materials for crafting and repairs.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bpiLPow.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xh0oT54.png[/img]

[b]Battle Damage:[/b]

Weapons damaged in combat will retain their battle scars even after being repaired, unless you replace them at a shipyard. This will add a layer of authenticity and storytelling to your ship’s journey.

[h2]In-Engine Optimizations[/h2]

We’ve been hard at work optimising our models to ensure smooth gameplay. Here’s a quick overview:

[b]Optimization Process:[/b]

[list]
[*] Initial Models: Below is an example of a model straight out of Blender, originally around 15K polygons.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yLlfkvp.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Optimised Models: After optimization, we reduce the model to about 6K polygons without sacrificing much detail.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jhwFoEA.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Level of Detail (LOD) Profiles: Each model then gets LOD profiles, reducing the polygons further as the camera moves away. This process can bring the model down to less than 3K polygons. At this distance, the cannon will still be recognizable, but the game won’t need to render all the finer details, leading to faster rendering and smoother gameplay.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CudRmqt.png[/img]

[h2]Rigging and Playtesting[/h2]

[b]Rigging for Gameplay:[/b]
We’re currently rigging all weapons for in-game testing. Once this is complete, these weapons will be playable, integrated with our modular component system. This modular approach will allow us to introduce new weapons regularly without requiring full game updates.

[h2]Join the Conversation[/h2]


We value your feedback and ideas! If you’d like to get involved or share your thoughts, join our Discord community. We're always eager to hear from you and incorporate your suggestions into the game.

Thanks for following our development journey, and stay tuned for more updates!

[b]See you in the skies, Nomads![/b]

notes.title: 0.15 Workshop update
notes.notes:
Hi Nomads,

Unfortunate News if your ship was created in 0.14 then it will no longer be compatible with 0.15 due to how panels are calculated

If you wish to try and convert your ships do so at your own risk

How to convert an Old Ship

1) Open the console the ` Key (The key next to the number 1) 

2) Type run-planar-processor accept

3) Press Enter

4) Wait for successful or unsuccessful error

Save Ship / Fix panels and upload to workshop.

Old Ships will now be marked as incompatible due to multiple bug reports of missing panels on workshop ships which isn't a bug.

Thanks for the ongoing support!

Team ZaviiNet

notes.title: Update 0.15 Has Dropped
notes.notes:
Hi Nomads, 

Sorry for the Delay,  We've been having Build Issues with the Server and had to rebuild the machine to allow us to publish this build, We also had to do some pretty hefty optimisations to ensure the current version of the game ran faster than the old version. 

We've been testing for the past month and we feel 0.15 is ready for public testing.

All bugs found this week will be fixed this week for this build as the public stress test will be larger than the small supporter / QA branch testers. Any bugs report them here, on discord or email hello@zaviinetstudios.com

We Aim to have a Steam Build out later today when Steam Distributes it across the globe

Thanks for you Continued Support, See you in the skies soon Nomad!

Team ZaviiNet

notes.title: 0.14 Pre-Alpha Release
notes.notes:
Thanks for Support, Introducing 0.14

We've been working very hard on 0.14 the de-bugging phase of 0.14 has been completed. The next major version is now 0.15 and will include development for a majority of the UI in the game in addition to several multiplayer related data syncing (inventory, character data, etc). 

Our First major update will be the release of the Island Creator which will allow you to create islands for Voids. Over the next few weeks you will notice alot of graphical updates as well as major bug fixes.

Thanks for sticking by we hope 0.14 is welcomed by all.

notes.title: Co-Op Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes:
Last night we attempted our first shot at multiplayer We managed a stable 3 player Game with 3 players all joining from across the globe, While it was not perfect we managed to look at each other, play a quick game of hide and seek and watch each other fail as we attempted to get around to other islands. 

We're calling this a success but we're far from perfect just yet we're hard at work patching it up to make it functional for our first Co-Op Update coming out in a few weeks time.

We Hope this news brings you some joy. 

[i][u]This Test was done using a Dedicated Server [/u][/i]
